name: HelixVision
summary: A SteamVR driver that takes Geo-11 / 3D Vision stereo output and pipes it into a SteamVR headset for immersive viewing of 3D Vision fixes. Allows Geo-11 games to be played in a VR headset as a virtual cinema or stereo environment. The reverse of the UEVR→VRto3D pipeline.
compatibility_notes: Primarily of historical and enthusiast interest. Requires an active Geo-11 fix and SteamVR headset. Game performance must sustain VR framerates. Not actively maintained.
